{{Historical content}} {{Event content}} {{Infobox quest |icon = |image =Into the Inferno banner.png |location =[[Shoreline]], [[Lighthouse]] |given by =[[Prapor]] |reward = |reputation = |time limit = |quest number = |previous =[[Provide Cover]] |leads to =[[Before the Rain]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Good of you to drop by! Got a job for you, cargos again. It seems someone has figured out that some of the equipment has fallen into the wrong hands. But that is not the problem. We got word of an important airdrop they will target immediately if they see it. We're gonna have to work hard to get it. Keep it as confidential as possible. The key is to make sure you don't get spotted with the package. Get a special yellow RSP flare at the coast. They're stashed at high elevations, like roofs and towers. Then find a spot somewhere out of the way and shoot it. The necessary people will recognize it and send the package. Wait for it and take whatever's in it. Then, run to stash the devices at the designated spots at the Lighthouse. Go straight from the coast, it'll be quicker. Do it all in one go, don't get killed or go back to your bunker until you've finished the job. Oh, and avoid shelling, obviously. This equipment can't be wasted. Serious people are interested in this matter, and mister Lightkeeper expects to hear from me when the task is completed.}} ==Objectives== * Find the [[KOSA UAV electronic jamming device (Cream of the Crop)|KOSA UAV electronic jamming device]] [[Found in raid|in raid]] * Use the transit from [[Shoreline]] to [[Lighthouse]] * Stash the [[KOSA UAV electronic jamming device (Cream of the Crop)|KOSA device]] on the second floor of the yacht club cottage on [[Lighthouse]] ==Rewards== * +52,600 [[EXP]] * 195,000 Roubles ** 204,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 224,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 3× [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Blue)]] * 3× [[Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine]] * 5× [[Bottle of Pevko Light beer]] * Unlocks achievement [[Achievements#Event_achievements|Highway to the Danger Zone]] {{quote|The task was difficult, but you did it perfectly, soldier! Now all that remains is to find out who brought such rare tools to Tarkov and for what purpose. But that's my concern, you don't need to get involved. I've got a good reward for you. My guys intercepted some Scavs, they had some special RSP flares on them. Should be useful!}} ==Guide== {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in Raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:KOSA UAV electronic jamming device (Cream of the Crop) Icon.png|link=KOSA UAV electronic jamming device (Cream of the Crop)]] |[[KOSA UAV electronic jamming device (Cream of the Crop)|KOSA UAV electronic jamming device]] |1 |Handover item !Yes |- ![[File:Special Yellow Flare Icon.png|link=RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Special Yellow)]] |[[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Special Yellow)]] |1 |Required !Yes |Must be fired into the sky. |} The [[KOSA UAV electronic jamming device (Cream of the Crop)|KOSA UAV electronic jamming device]] spawns in special airdrop crates that get dropped after firing a [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Special Yellow)]] '''into the sky''' on [[Shoreline]]. The flare also causes a mortar fire barrage on the launch location.
